Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class NumberedList<N extends Numbered>

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.StoryGraphCollection<T>
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.StoryGraphList<N>
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.NumberedList<N>
Type Parameters:
N - the type of numbered element in this collection
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<N>, RandomAccess
Direct Known Subclasses:
EdgeList, ExplanationList, NodeList, PlanList, StateList
public abstract class NumberedList<N extends Numbered> extends StoryGraphList<N>
A collection of numbered story graph elements of the same type. An element can be accessed by its ID number.

This collection stores its elements in a custom array list that can hold up to BigArrayList.MAX_CAPACITY elements.

Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • add

      protected void add(N numbered)
      Puts a new element into this collection at the index of its ID number. It is expected that the element's ID number will be the size of this collection at the time it is added, otherwise an existing element will be overridden or null elements will be added to the collection.

      This method updates the story graph's meta-data with the new number of elements of this type. It also updates the last modified timestamp.

      Parameters:
      numbered - the element to add

    • sort

      public boolean sort(Comparator<? super N> comparator, Status status)
      Sorts and renumbers the elements of this collection based on the given comparator. If the order of any elements changes, their ID numbers will be reassigned to be sequential.

      If this method modifies the order of elements, it updates the story graph's meta-data last modified timestamp.

      Parameters:
      comparator - the comparator that defines the new order of elements
      status - a status object that will be updated while this method runs to reflect its current progress
      Returns:
      true if any elements were reordered, false if all elements remained in the same order

    • prune

      protected boolean prune(Predicate<Object> predicate, Status status)
      Description copied from class: StoryGraphCollection
      For each element in this collection, this method removes any reference in that element to other elements whose ID numbers have been set to Settings.PRUNED and, if the given predicate returns true, sets the element's ID number to Settings.PRUNED to signal that it should also be removed from this graph. This method does not remove elements from this collection for which the predicate returns true; it only sets their ID numbers to signal that they should later be removed, which typically happens when the collection is renumbered.
      Specified by:
      prune in class StoryGraphCollection<N extends Numbered>
      Parameters:
      predicate - a predicate that specifies which elements should be removed from from a story graph
      status - a status object that will be updated while this method runs to reflect its current progress
      Returns:
      true if the predicate returned true for any elements in this collection
